answer: The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Written in a factual sentences, no filler register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The lantern of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Every claim climbs the harbor of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the ferrous re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
